lessons.text: Baseline: val_loss 0.1838 in 2719 steps at 11.48M params (exp 0)
Exp 1's cosine was inverted and exp 3's cosine was a no-op (missing math import); correct cosine decay is still untested (exp 1, 3, human review)
Widening DiT from 256 to 384 hidden dim regresses val_loss ~1.5%; fewer steps (1525 vs 2719) outweigh capacity; LR 1e-3 recovers more (exp 2, 5, 9)
Warmdown shape is not a lever (cosine vs linear within noise), but warmup removal hurts ~0.7%; keep warmup (exp 3, 6)
EMA implementation crashed: lazy arrays without mx.eval per step caused memory growth, and model.update(ema_state) failed due to parameter name mismatch (exp 4)
Removing text encoder for learned embedding improves val_loss ~0.5% via +12% steps; conditioning quality loss is minor on CIFAR-10 (exp 5)
Removing warmup regresses val_loss ~0.7% at LR 5e-4 (exp 6), ~0.45% with beta2=0.95 (exp 8), and ~0.2% at LR 1e-3 (exp 11); warmup is protective across LR and beta2 (exp 6, 8, 11)
Lowering AdamW beta2 from 0.99 to 0.95 gives negligible val_loss change (-0.06%) and does not enable warmup removal (exp 7, 8)
LR 1e-3 with warmup beats 5e-4 by ~1.5% val_loss and adds steps; adaLN-Zero tolerates higher LR, but removing warmup at 1e-3 regresses ~0.2% (exp 9, 11)
Batch 256 regresses val_loss ~2% vs 128; step count drops 46% and memory 5.6GB; keep batch 128 (exp 10)
Weight decay 0.01 regresses val_loss ~0.14% vs 0.0 at LR 1e-3; mild regularization not helpful in short budget (exp 12)
